tasks.prompt:
Where does SQL dialect transpilation / dialect normalization happen in this SQLMesh checkout? Identify the primary module and the key entrypoint symbol. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <module-prefixed symbol>
file: <path relative to repo root>
lines: <start-end>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Trace what happens when a user runs `sqlmesh plan`. Start from the Click CLI command and name the Context/GenericContext method it calls. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
cli_symbol: <CLI function qualified_name or file:line>
callee_qualified_name: <plan method qualified_name>
file: <file of the plan method>
lines: <start-end of the plan method>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Which files depend on Context.render / GenericContext.render, and who calls it? Name the callee's qualified_name (the defining method) and at least one caller file. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <callee module-prefixed name>
file: <one caller file path relative to repo root>
lines: <a line number from that caller>
evidence: <one short sentence>

What does the snapshot evaluation pipeline inherit from? Focus on EvaluationStrategy in sqlmesh/core/snapshot/evaluator.py: name its qualified_name, its direct base, and at least two concrete subclasses. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <EvaluationStrategy module-prefixed name>
parent_classes: <comma-separated bases>
child_classes: <comma-separated subclass names>
file: sqlmesh/core/snapshot/evaluator.py
evidence: <one short sentence>

How do I safely rename model-kind-related config parsing? Identify the central `create_model_kind` helper and at least one call site that would break if it were renamed. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <create_model_kind module-prefixed name>
file: <one caller file path relative to repo root>
lines: <a line number from that caller>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Find every place the exception ConflictingPlanError is raised (not merely imported). Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <the exception's module-prefixed name>
raise_locations: <comma-separated file:line entries>
evidence: <one short sentence>

What is the public API surface of the sqlmesh.core.model package? List key modules and at least two public symbols exported from sqlmesh/core/model/__init__.py. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
directory: sqlmesh/core/model
modules: <comma-separated module filenames under that package>
public_symbols: <comma-separated exported names>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Which files import from sqlmesh.core.dialect, and what do they use from it? List every importer under sqlmesh/ and web/ (exclude tests/). For each file, name the imported symbols. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
imported_module: sqlmesh/core/dialect.py
importers: <one line per importer: path — symbols>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Summarize the structure of the plan / diff subsystem without reading every file. Name the plan package directory, context_diff module, and at least two key types (e.g. Plan, PlanBuilder, ContextDiff). Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
directory: sqlmesh/core/plan
related_modules: <comma-separated paths>
key_types: <comma-separated type names>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Where is the CLI flag `--forward-only` handled end-to-end? Identify the Click option site and the GenericContext.plan parameter it feeds. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
cli_file: <path where --forward-only is declared>
cli_lines: <line of the option>
callee_qualified_name: <plan method that accepts forward_only>
param: forward_only
evidence: <one short sentence>
